import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("svg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.offsetbox import OffsetImage, AnnotationBbox
import numpy as np
from io import BytesIO

fig, ax = plt.subplots()

arr_img = np.zeros((10, 10, 4))
imagebox = OffsetImage(arr_img, zoom=0.1)
imagebox.image.axes = ax

xy = [0.3, 0.55]

ab = AnnotationBbox(imagebox, xy,
                    xybox=(120., -80.),
                    xycoords='data',
                    boxcoords="offset points",
                    pad=0.5,
                    arrowprops=dict(
                        arrowstyle="->",
                        connectionstyle="angle,angleA=0,angleB=90,rad=3")
                    )
ab.set_gid('My_label')
ax.add_artist(ab)

print(f"GID = {ab.get_gid()}")

with BytesIO() as fd:
    fig.savefig(fd, format="svg")
    buf = fd.getvalue().decode()

print("gid in svg:", 'My_label' in buf)
count = buf.count('My_label')
print("occurrences:", count)

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("svg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.offsetbox import OffsetImage, AnnotationBbox
import numpy as np
from io import BytesIO

fig, ax = plt.subplots()

arr_img = np.zeros((10, 10, 4))
imagebox = OffsetImage(arr_img, zoom=0.1)
imagebox.image.axes = ax

xy = [0.3, 0.55]

ab = AnnotationBbox(imagebox, xy,
                    xybox=(120., -80.),
                    xycoords='data',
                    boxcoords="offset points",
                    pad=0.5,
                    arrowprops=dict(
                        arrowstyle="->",
                        connectionstyle="angle,angleA=0,angleB=90,rad=3")
                    )
ab.set_gid('My_label')
ax.add_artist(ab)

print(f"GID = {ab.get_gid()}")

with BytesIO() as fd:
    fig.savefig(fd, format="svg")
    buf = fd.getvalue().decode()

print("gid in svg:", 'My_label' in buf)
print("occurrences:", buf.count('My_label'))

from io import BytesIO

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
imagebox = OffsetImage(np.zeros((10, 10, 4)), zoom=0.1)
imagebox.image.axes = ax
ab = AnnotationBbox(imagebox, [0.3, 0.55], xybox=(120., -80.), xycoords='data',
